detail: fn-apc-sub-stored-octets selects fn-peer-relayed-octets (owner-parse-carried.lisp:227-229), which calls fn-pu-relay-article (peer-inbound.lisp:301-307; path-update.lisp:927-933). fn-pu-walk-loop (path-update.lisp:185-220) walks the header into a reverse accumulator and revappends it onto the shared body suffix: H' fresh cells plus an H'-cell accumulator, and fn-pu-line (path-update.lisp:136-142) builds temporary line lists in two passes. The completion recomputes cells the take already generated. Required: the transit completion's allocation bounded by the generated Path delta, not the header length, stated over the take's header (a cost row or a heap-test case with a header-dominated transit article as the tooth).
title: transit completion rebuilds the relayed header (fn-peer-relayed-octets) instead of reusing the take's generated header: allocation O(header + Path), article-sized for header-dominated input
